config firewall local-in-policy6
    edit 63
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-a30000000012
        set intf "host01"
        set srcaddr "netops-a3r2-outer"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set service "ALL_ICMP6"
        set schedule "always"
        set status disable
    next
end
